g1-implement.title: Doctrine + shared contract + Commander consumption: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF and dispatch via run_crew.py (external backend). Task: (1) NEW skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md — the shared parallel-alternatives contract, SPUN OUT of explorer's EXCURSION_BRIEF design-it-twice type (not a copy of it): fill-in brief for N>=2 parallel agents each under one named distinct constraint (constraint menu: minimal-interface / max-flexibility / common-caller-first / ports-and-adapters for interfaces; smallest-diff / most-testable / best-seam-placement for plans); comparison axes depth/locality/seam/testability; opinionated recommendation or hybrid, never a menu; frame-the-problem-while-agents-run block the orchestrator presents to the human, explicitly marked 'not a proposal'; untaken-road record (named skip + reason, surfaced at approval); panel-vs-single record (choice + rationale, surfaced at approval). Rich template over prose — the mechanism lives here. (2) skills/_shared/global-orchestrator.md gains a 'Design-it-twice (standard, not optional)' section symmetric with the critical-review section: trigger (any skill authoring a plan or introducing a load-bearing interface); bias-to-yes (skip only genuinely-trivial, surfaced as a named untaken road); count/panel scaled by weight as a surfaced choice ('when in doubt, panel'); human-only convergence; names design-it-twice-brief.md as the reusable contract (explorer's excursion design-it-twice type is the same contract in its design-phase form). (3) Same file, critical-review section: competitive-critic human-opt-in option — panel critics judged against each other on serious confirmed findings; MUST state that competition modulates critic effort never disposition: critics still never self-triage, the human disposes every finding (this is the erosion guard); tension vs never-bias-the-reviewer stated. (4) skills/commander/SKILL.md Mission frame section: SHORT consumption paragraph superseding the epic-only critic sentence — plan-alternatives + cold plan critic (reads candidate plan + mission frame only) both before plan-approved, per the shared standard and design-it-twice-brief contract; points at doctrine rather than restating rules. (5) skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json plan task: imperative names alternatives + critic + loud-skip + surfaced panel choice + the brief; ADD postcondition c4 (check null, attested): 'plan-alternatives run (or skip surfaced as named untaken road); cold plan critic run; panel-vs-single choice surfaced'; JSON valid; freeze/amend semantics untouched. (6) scripts/install_constellation.py: add 'design-it-twice-brief.md' to the _GLOBAL_ORCHESTRATOR bundle tuple (one line — ship path for the shared contract; dry-run must pass). Register: dense, agent-facing, departures-only. Evidence: ruling-traceability table (q1/q2/q2b ruling -> exact sentence). The g1-integrate c1 chain is the frozen mechanical invariant — make it pass as written; do not invent additional check proxies. Required exact tokens (case-insensitive, hyphen/space free per the tolerant greps): 'untaken road', 'not a proposal', 'competitive-critic' (hyphenated), 'self-triage', 'when in doubt, panel', 'bias to yes' or 'bias-to-yes'.

g1-review.title: Doctrine + shared contract + Commander consumption: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill REVIEWER_HANDOFF from the gate plan and IMPLEMENTER_RESULT; dispatch via run_crew.py (external backend). Named review focus items: (1) side-by-side symmetry read: new design-it-twice section vs critical-review section — structure, register, weight-scaling, human-only authority, contract pointer. (2) Faithful encoding of q1/q2/q2b rulings against the ruling-traceability table, not memory. (3) COMPETITIVE-CRITIC EROSION GUARD: verify the option's text preserves human-only triage — competition affects critic effort only; critics never self-triage; human disposes every finding. (4) Internal consistency of commander/SKILL.md — the old epic-only critic sentence must not survive in contradiction. (5) design-it-twice-brief.md is a genuine spin-out: covers the excursion type's contract (constraints, axes, recommendation-not-menu) plus the three new fields (not-a-proposal framing, untaken road, panel-vs-single record), usable by explorer, commander, and admiral alike. (6) Spine plan task carries c4 and stays schema-valid. (7) Non-goals: no explorer edits, no engine change; diff confined to the five owned files.

g2-close.title: Explorer refs + acceptance trace + rubric'd dogfood (reasoning gate)
g2-close.imperative: REASONING GATE — crew waiver: deliverables are two additive reference lines (mechanically fenced by working-tree diff invariants), work-area synthesis, and a dogfood whose independent verification is supplied INSIDE the gate by a cold-context subagent judged against a PRE-REGISTERED rubric. Steps: (1) Explorer refs (Commander-direct): one line in skills/explorer/SKILL.md naming the shared standard in global-orchestrator doctrine; one line in skills/explorer/templates/EXCURSION_BRIEF.template.md noting its design-it-twice type is the design-phase form of the shared design-it-twice-brief.md contract. Additions only; no machinery change. (2) Author .agent-work/issue-99/DOGFOOD_RUBRIC.md BEFORE dispatching the dogfood: a toy issue containing a deliberate trap — one genuinely-trivial sub-part whose correct handling is a SKIP that must surface as a named untaken road — plus a complexity profile where panel-vs-single is a real call; pre-register the expected outputs (N agents with distinct named constraints from the menu; not-a-proposal framing; the trap skip surfaced; panel choice with rationale) and the fail conditions. (3) Dispatch a fresh subagent with ONLY the new doctrine section, the new commander plan-step wording, and design-it-twice-brief.md (no authoring context) plus the toy issue; judge the transcript against the rubric; save to .agent-work/issue-99/DOGFOOD_TRANSCRIPT.md. A rubric fail is a real finding: reopen g1. (4) Author .agent-work/issue-99/ACCEPTANCE_TRACE.md: every #99 acceptance criterion, scope item, ruling, and lift -> file+section + the mechanical check proving it (reference g1's ruling-traceability table rather than redoing it); every row resolves.
